limitations: Backward input-demand calculation only: reactions, coefficients and yields are supplied, not predicted.
User-supplied isolated-yield sources are not independently verified; user_scenario means a hypothetical assumption, not an observed experiment.

Stoichiometric demand equations are arithmetic, not validation of a chemically balanced equation. Atom/charge balance and coproducts are unknown; listed masses must not be used as a total-mass conservation assertion.

Reagents are consumed external inputs, not recursively synthesized or recycled. Each equivalent is per mole of its explicit reaction-reactant or theoretical-product reference; no limiting reagent is inferred.
No solvent or catalyst quantities, purity corrections, stock concentrations, residuals, purge, toxicity, patient exposure or clinical dosing recommendation are inferred.
Target mass is the explicit desired material mass. Purity is unknown; no potency, salt/free-base or purity correction is applied.
Canonical identity preserves complete salts/disconnected components, charge, isotopes and stereochemistry; salt/free-base or stereoisomer equivalence is not assumed.
Any missing required reaction-specific input or unsupported yield basis prevents all input-amount results; no default coefficient or yield is supplied.
